definitions.explanation: Technology that overlays digital information (images, sounds, text) onto the real-world environment, typically viewed through a smartphone or special glasses.

examples.japanese: AR{機能|きのう}を{使|つか}う。
ARゲームが{流行|はや}っている。
ARで{家具|かぐ}の{配置|はいち}をシミュレーションできる。
examples.english: You can simulate furniture placement with AR.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Abbreviation of English "Augmented Reality." Pronounced えーあーる in Japanese.

USAGE:
AR overlays digital information onto the real world, typically viewed through a smartphone camera or special glasses. Popularized in Japan through games like Pokemon GO.

COMMON APPLICATIONS:
- ゲーム: location-based and interactive games
- ショッピング: virtual try-on, furniture placement
- ナビゲーション: navigation and wayfinding
- {教育|きょういく}: educational overlays and interactive learning

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ARアプリ: AR application
- AR{技術|ぎじゅつ}: AR technology
- AR{機能|きのう}: AR function/feature
- AR{体験|たいけん}: AR experience

SIMILAR WORDS:
- AR ({拡張|かくちょう}{現実|げんじつ}): digital overlay on the real world
- VR ({仮想|かそう}{現実|げんじつ}): fully immersive virtual environment
- MR ({複合|ふくごう}{現実|げんじつ}): mixed reality, blending real and virtual

The full Japanese term {拡張|かくちょう}{現実|げんじつ} exists but the English abbreviation AR is far more common in everyday use.
